About Me

Who I Am

I'm Sneha Mundodgi, a B.Tech Computer Science student at MIT Vishwaprayag University, Solapur. My academic journey is driven by a deep curiosity for problem-solving and logical thinking — passions that drew me to computer science in the first place.

My career goal is to become a software engineer who builds impactful, user-centred products. I aspire to work on projects that make a meaningful impact, combining strong theoretical foundations with practical engineering skills.

Beyond academics, I enjoy exploring new technologies, learning about AI, and staying curious in the ever-evolving world of tech. I believe continuous learning is the cornerstone of growth.
